faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AffProf.

items.q: What happens when a link breaks?
items.a: AffProf detects it automatically and sends you an email alert with the broken link details and a link to your dashboard to fix it. Pro users also get automatic fallback redirects to a backup URL.

Instead of sharing a long ugly affiliate URL, AffProf gives you a clean short link like affprof.com/go/blueyeti (or yourdomain.com/go/blueyeti on Pro). Every click on that short link is tracked before redirecting to the original affiliate URL.

items.q: Can I use my own domain for short links?
items.a: Yes, on the Pro plan you can connect your own domain so your short links look like go.yourbrand.com/productname.
On the Pro plan you can add your logo to the center of every QR code. Perfect for YouTube thumbnails, Instagram stories, and printed materials.
Any affiliate platform — Amazon Associates, ShareASale, Impact, CJ Affiliate, Rakuten, ClickBank, and any custom URL.

items.q: Can I import my existing links?
items.a: Yes, on Pro you can upload a CSV file with all your existing links and import them in bulk.

items.q: Is there a free trial for Pro?
items.a: Yes, Pro comes with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
